verdicts.reason: A blows the 'THE ULTRA TASTING TEAM' attribution up to a bold lime block that outweighs the quote, so the hierarchy is inverted. The quote shrinks to small text with ragged breaks ('bright, a / little bitter'). The purple circle is moved to the top corner behind the quote mark and no longer frames the can, which is small. B keeps the quote as the clear dominant element at a readable size, but it moves the attribution above the quote as tiny text, which breaks the reading order and leaves it hard to read. B's circle is also detached from the can at the top, and its short lines ('Like a', 'soon.') wrap raggedly. B has the better hierarchy and is fixable; A is broken.
